overview: The Medford City Council approved the city's Year 48 Community Development Block Grant Action Plan following a public hearing. The council also passed several resolutions addressing local infrastructure, commercial trash pickup in Medford Square, and municipal facility operations.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: The council approved past meeting records along with committee reports on council rules, leaf blower regulations, and a beautification ordinance.

items.title: Massachusetts Walk, Bike, and Roll to School Day
items.summary: The council recognized Massachusetts Walk, Bike, and Roll to School Day and highlighted safe routes to schools.

items.title: CDBG Year 48 Annual Action Plan Public Hearing
items.summary: Following a public hearing, the council voted to waive the waiting period and approve the submission of the city's Year 48 Community Development Block Grant Action Plan application.

items.title: Medford Square Rubbish Pickup
items.summary: The council passed a resolution requesting that the mayor collaborate with the Chamber of Commerce and Waste Management on a improved trash collection plan for Medford Square.

items.title: Crystal Campbell Fountain Reopening
items.summary: The council approved a resolution asking the administration to reopen the Crystal Campbell Fountain at the Senior Center.

items.title: Brook Street Infrastructure Promises
items.summary: The council passed an amended resolution requesting an update on promised sidewalk and safety repairs on Brook Street and directing the clerk to send previous committee reports to the DPW commissioner.

items.title: South Street and Main Street Intersection Project
items.summary: The council passed a resolution requesting a progress and financing update from the administration regarding planned improvements at South Street and Main Street.
